title: VK-only Write Multiple Coils: issue_structural_analogue protocol sequence for buffer overflow relation
purpose: Combine the issue-supported vulnerable structure with a conservative model-prior protocol form without copying the crash payload.

messages.label: write eight packed coils from address 0x0010

expected_behavior: A conforming server should consume one data byte for eight coils and return a normal function 0f write confirmation containing the starting address and quantity.
constraints_preserved: Modbus/TCP MBAP header and protocol identifier are valid
MBAP length 0008 equals the unit byte plus seven-byte PDU
Packed coil payload contains exactly one data byte
issue_safety_notes: This preserves the issue-related focus on read/write buffer sizing and field relationships while changing the operation and all payload values. It does not copy the reported read-coils response or any crash payload.
